q: What CBAM figure does an EU buyer need for hot rolled coil from Smederevo?
title: Smederevo hot rolled coil: the CBAM figure
short: Smederevo is a blast furnace works, so its coil carries coke, sinter and furnace emissions. Ask for a verified figure per tonne of coil for the period. Serbia has no carbon price to deduct, so the full CBAM charge applies to that figure.
audience: EU importers and service centres buying coil, plate and tinplate from Serbia

ul: Coke and sinter, made on site or bought.
Bought slabs or pig iron as precursors.

p: Reported, not charged, for steel. Serbia's grid is lignite heavy, which buyers doing Scope 3 will notice.
Each product needs its own figure. Downstream steps add their own fuel and power.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
